During the [[Kymoodon Era]], a '''clan battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. The battle was fought by [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]] enhanced [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] berserkers belonging to two rival [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]]. The event took place after an [[Assault on Lexrul|assault]] on Lexrul by Hutt-backed forces in which many of the colonists were enslaved, although some escaped and witnessed the following clan battle. The battle was mentioned [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later by [[Thunys Albegron]], an academician of Popular Studies, during the [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]] held on the planet [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clan battle was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
